title: bf-param
description: `bf-param` defines a named, typed parameter associated with a `bf-instrument`, supporting one or more values of type cont (0.0–1.0), midi (0–127), bool (0 or 1), or bang. Its arguments specify the instrument name, parameter name, number of values, type, and—as shown by the examples—an additional numeric argument; for multi-value parameters, the first two inlets are used together to set a value at an index.
